pairs: Egressa est autem Dina filia Liæ ut videret mulieres regionis illius.
Then Dinah, the daughter of Leah, went out to see the women of that region.
Quam cum vidisset Sichem filius Hemor Hevæi,
And when Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite, the leader of that land,
had seen her, he fell in love with her.
et rapuit, et dormivit cum illa,
And so he seized her and slept with her,
Et conglutinata est anima ejus cum ea,
And his soul was closely bound to her, and,
since she was sorrowful, he soothed her with flattery.
Et pergens ad Hemor patrem suum:
“Obtain this girl for me as a mate.”
Quod cum audisset Jacob absentibus filiis,
But when Jacob had heard this,
since his sons were absent and he was occupied in pasturing the cattle,
he remained silent until they came back.
Egresso autem Hemor patre Sichem ut loqueretur ad Jacob,
Then, when Hamor, the father of Shechem, had gone out to speak to Jacob,
ecce filii ejus veniebant de agro:
behold, his sons arrived from the field.
eo quod fœdam rem operatus esset in Israël et, violata filia Jacob,
because he had done a filthy thing in Israel and, in violating a daughter of Jacob,
Locutus est itaque Hemor ad eos:
And so Hamor spoke to them:
Sichem filii mei adhæsit anima filiæ vestræ:
“The soul of my son Shechem has become attached to your daughter.
Give her to him as a wife.
And let us celebrate marriages with one with another.
The land is in your power:
Sed et Sichem ad patrem et ad fratres ejus ait:
And Shechem even said to her father and to her brothers:
“May I find favor in your sight,
and I will freely bestow what you will ask.
tantum date mihi puellam hanc uxorem.
Only give me this girl as a wife.”
Responderunt filii Jacob Sichem et patri ejus in dolo,
The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and his father with deceit,
being enraged at the rape of their sister:
“We are not able to do what you ask,
nec dare sororem nostram homini incircumciso:
nor to give our sister to an uncircumcised man.
But we may succeed in this, so as to be allied with you,
if you are willing to become like us,
et circumcidatur in vobis omne masculini sexus;
and if all the male sex among you will be circumcised.
tunc dabimus et accipiemus mutuo filias vestras ac nostras:
Then we will mutually give and receive your daughters as well as ours;
and we will live with you,
and we will become one people.
But if you will not be circumcised,
nec distulit adolescens quin statim quod petebatur expleret:
Neither did the young man cause any delay; in fact he immediately fulfilled what was requested.
For he loved the girl very much,
et ipse erat inclytus in omni domo patris sui.
and he was well-known throughout his father’s house.
And entering at the gate of the city,
and they want to live among us.
Let them trade in the land and cultivate it,
it is in need of cultivation.
We will receive their daughters as wives,
and we will give them ours.
Unum est quo differtur tantum bonum:
There is one thing that prevents so great a good:
whether we will circumcise our males,
imitating the ritual of their nation.
if only we will acquiesce to this,
Assensique sunt omnes, circumcisis cunctis maribus.
And they all agreed to circumcise every one of the males.
when the pain of the wound was greatest,
two of the sons of Jacob,
boldly entered the city with swords.
And they put to death all of the males.
They killed Hamor and Shechem together,
tollentes Dinam de domo Sichem sororem suam.
taking their sister Dinah from the house of Shechem.
irruerunt super occisos ceteri filii Jacob:
the other sons of Jacob rushed over the slain,
et depopulati sunt urbem in ultionem stupri.
and they plundered the city in vengeance for the rape.
cunctaque vastantes quæ in domibus et in agris erant,
and laying waste to everything else that was in their houses and in their fields,
parvulos quoque eorum et uxores duxerunt captivas.
they also took their little ones and their wives captive.
When they had boldly completed these acts,
Jacob said to Simeon and Levi:
and you have made me hateful to the Canaanites and the Perizzites,
and then both I and my house will be wiped away.”
Numquid ut scorto abuti debuere sorore nostra?
“Should they abuse our sister like a prostitute?”
